page.notes: The text runs straight from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". The "Y" below the text is read as a gathering signature, but it could be a catchword. "IesuChristo" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. The "2." mid-line is a numbered point inside the text, not a heading. Long s is normalised to plain s, and "teft" is read as "est" per the abbreviation rule.
